query: INSERT INTO payday_allocations (household_id, month_id, template_id, title, section, position, kind, expense_group_id, expense_group_name, category_id, subcategory_id, category_name, subcategory_name, amount, notes, source, source_key) SELECT household_id, $2, id, title, section, position, kind, expense_group_id, expense_group_name, category_id, subcategory_id, category_name, subcategory_name, amount, notes, 'template', 'template:' || recurrence_id::text FROM payday_templates WHERE household_id=$1 AND starts_on <= $3 AND (ends_before IS NULL OR ends_before > $3) ON CONFLICT (household_id, month_id, source_key) DO NOTHING
